==Biography==
'''TitaN''' is from [[wikipedia:en:Manaus|Manaus]], Brazil. He got known in the Brazilian scene as part of the temporary lineup that played for [[Ilha da Macacada Gaming]] (later [[KaBuM! IDM Gaming]]) at the [[XLG SuperCup 2016]]. He stayed in the team officially as a sub for the CBLOL, and after the partnership between KaBuM! and Ilha da Macacada was dropped he, along with the KaBuM! IDM lineup, joined [[KaBuM! e-Sports]]. He played as substitute midlaner in his first split in the team, but the team would soon be relegated to [[BRCC 2017 Split 2]] after being defeated by [[ProGaming Esports]]. 
===2017 and 2018 in [[KaBuM! Esports]]===
After some changes to the team roster in the [[BRCC 2017 Split 2]], '''TitaN''' roleswapped to the botlane, where he managed to win his first title and the team was promoted back to the [[CBLOL 2017 Split 1|CBLOL]]. In 2017, his career was a success: he won both splits in the same year with his new teammates, who included [[dyNquedo]] and [[Ranger]], won the [[Rift Rivals 2018 LLN-CLS-CBLOL|Rift Rivals]] in the same year and played in the [[MSI 2018|MSI]] and [[Worlds 2018|Worlds]].
===2019 and joining [[RED Canids]]===
In 2019, the [[CBLOL 2019 Split 1|CBLOL]] format changed, which ended up punishing [[KaBuM! Esports|KaBuM!]], and the team didn't qualify to playoffs. In the second split, he joined [[RED Canids]], a team that was playing in the [[BRCC 2019 Split 2|BRCC]], where he achieved good results despite finishing 3rd in playoffs after being defeated by [[ProGaming Esports]].
===2020 and Promotion to the CBLOL===
In 2020, [[RED Canids]] started using a korean midlaner, [[Sky (Kim Ha-neul)|Sky]], and had a few difficulties in the [[BRCC 2020 Split 1]]. Having to play in the promotion series to still be able to qualify to [[BRCC 2020 Split 2]], they managed to qualify back to the BRCC and won their first BRCC title, qualifying to CBLOL, unknown that their team would be chosen for the new franchise model anyway.
===2021 and 2022 splits===
In the [[CBLOL 2021 Split 1|CBLOL]], they had a ok run after finishing 3rd in regular season and fourth in [[CBLOL 2021 Split 1 Playoffs|Playoffs]]. After changes in the playoffs of the second split that added [[Grevthar]], a rookie academy player, to substitute [[Avenger (Adriano Perassoli)|Avenger]], they managed to win the [[CBLOL 2021 Split 1 Playoffs|second split]] and qualify for [[Worlds 2021]], where they got to play against [[Tarzan (Lee Seung-yong)|Tarzan]] and [[icon]]'s [[LNG Esports|LNG]] and [[Chovy]] and [[Deft]]'s [[Hanwha Life Esports|Hanwha Life]].
In the [[CBLOL 2022 Split 1|first split of 2022]], his team managed to win another split, qualifying for the [[MSI 2022]]. They faced [[GALA]]'s [[Royal Never Give Up|RNG]] twice due to their first game being remade because of ping issues, and [[GALA]] got a pentakill in both games.
===2023 and joining [[paiN Gaming]]===
After two good years, the year of 2023 was a relatively bad one considering the team's players: they finished their run in both split's playoffs quickly after being defeated by [[FURIA]]. Despite that, '''TitaN''' was needing a change of pace after all those years with the same player base and internal issues with some players. After much talk with RED Canids' owner, JP, '''TitaN''' left [[RED Canids]], a team that he still considers until today the closest he had to a family in esports. He joined [[paiN Gaming]] in the end of the same year along with [[Kuri]], who he had played some time before in '''RED'''. 
===2024 season===
In 2024, they had a good start in the regular season, but due to the current state of teams in the tournament, [[paiN Gaming]] still had some difficulties defeating their newly emerged rival in CBLOL, [[LOUD]], who had won 3 consecutive splits. They eventually reached finals and took [[LOUD]] to a 5th game, but ended losing to the green team. The second split was a victorius, but weird one: with meta changes, the team relearned how they could beat [[LOUD]] in a BO5, but [[LOUD]] eventually was beaten first by the meta. They eventually won against '''LOUD''' in the [[CBLOL 2024 Split 2 Playoffs|playoffs]], and TitaN's old team, [[RED Canids]], finally put the greens to rest. The finals ended up being against the newly revamped [[Vivo Keyd Stars]], led by the prestigious coach [[SeeEl]], but TitaN's team had the upper hand, and defeated them in a 3-1 and qualifying to [[Worlds 2024]]. In Worlds, they reached a new milestone by finally making it out of Play In's and playing in the Swiss Stage. They ended up facing and losing to [[G2 Esports|G2]], [[T1]], in which '''TitaN''' and [[Kuri]] at least managed to get the first blood against [[Gumayusi]], and [[Team Liquid]], which eliminated [[paiN Gaming]] from the tournament.
===2025 Season===
In the first split of 2025, with the merger of [[LCS]] and [[CBLOL]] into the [[LTA]], [[TitaN]] remained in the core with the same roster that made it into Worlds Swiss in the previous year. Despite that, the team fell short after losing to [[LOUD]] in the [[LTA South 2025 Split 1|short Split 1]], making the team believe they needed a change. For [[LTA South 2025 Split 2|the second split]], the team brought in [[Roamer]] as the former midlaner [[dyNquedo]] retired to focus on other ideas. They managed to finish first in the regular season after beating [[FURIA]] by 2-1, but fell by 3-0 by the same team in the [[LTA South 2025 Split 2 Playoffs|Playoffs Finals]]. In [[LTA South 2025 Split 3|Split 3]], they finished 3rd, not even making into finals, after being beat 3-0 by [[RED Canids]] in the Playoffs stage. They still were qualified to [[LTA 2025 Championship]], but were defeated 3-0 by [[100T]].
=== 2026 Harassment case ===
:''More info: [[2026 TitaN Incident]]''
On January 12, 2026, despite being confirmed to remain with the team for the return of the [[CBLOL]], he was temporarily suspended from [[paiN Gaming]] after several accusations on X (formerly Twitter) were made by several women just a few days before the start of the CBLOL, including his ex-girlfriend with whom he had recently broken up, accusing him of infidelity and possible sexual interactions with minors. He was fully dismissed from the organization on March 10th after a police report was filed with the Federal Police in São Paulo, in which he was accused of ''rape of a vulnerable person, dissemination of pornography and sexual harassment''. On August 12th he made a post talking about the accusations made against him and stating that "there was no lawsuit whatsoever in his name to that effect."<ref>[https://x.com/titanlolOficial/status/2087677734952525971 TitaN's X Post] ''x.com''</ref> He also stated that he had evidence that witnesses had been bought off and that he would resolve the case in court.

General Trivia=
===General Trivia===
* Started his career as a midlaner but soon moved to the adcarry position.
* Known as one of the best players from the Northern region of Brazil.
* Known for his {{ci|lucian}} and his {{ci|ezreal}}.
* Was known early in his career for playing {{ci|vel'koz}} in the botlane.
* He is considered one of the biggest idols of [[RED Canids]] and he addressed his love for the organization in an open letter. <ref>[https://maisesports.com.br/especiais/matilha-ontem-e-sempre-titan-lol/ Matilha, ontem e sempre] ''maisesports.com.br''</ref>
* Known for shouting a lot on stage. His trademark is the catchphrase "Titanzada Xesquedele", which uses a slang coined by another player, [[Jovirone]]. <ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vY3hB7Mfvo TITANZADA XESQUEDELE PELO AMOR DE DEUS MLK (Portuguese)] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* He was publicly thanked by [[Marvin]] for his help in preparing for the [[CBLOL Academy 2024 Split 1 Playoffs|CBLOL Academy Finals]], which resulted in '''Marvin''''s first title.<ref>[https://x.com/ilhadaslendas/status/1784671230039040087 Ilha das Lendas' X Post] ''x.com''</ref> This happened again in [[Ignis Cup 2024 Split 1|Ignis Cup]], where he was thanked by [[Nallari]] and [[Rahkys]] for his contributions to the team.<ref>[https://x.com/CBLOL/status/1794851001725272571 CBLOL' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* There is a running gag about his {{ci|sivir}} gameplay due to his low winrate with the champion.

Non-League-related Trivia=
=== Non-League-related Trivia ===
* He said in a interview during [[CBLOL 2024 Split 1 Playoffs]] that he inherited his nickname '''TitaN''' from his father, whose name is also Alexandre.
* Since [[BrTT]] is nicknamed "Pai" (Father), he is often nicknamed the "Filho" (Son).
* He has a son named Thomas. <ref>[https://twitter.com/emizadaX/status/1751338552284086332 Tici's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* Is known for being an extremely competitive player and capable of playing several games at a high level, such as Counter Strike and Valorant. During the offseason between 2024 and 2025, he ended up not playing LoL for 3 months because he was dedicated to playing Counter Strike 2.<ref>[https://x.com/titanlolOficial/status/1883254255060234706 TitaN's X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
